false_positive_cost_if_blocked_inr.purpose: Synthetic business cost for blocking a genuine transaction.
false_positive_cost_if_blocked_inr.construction: Uses transaction amount, category-specific synthetic margin proxy, and customer activity friction proxy.
false_positive_cost_if_blocked_inr.warning: Synthetic evaluation proxy; do not present as a Razorpay or industry-standard cost model.

fraud_loss_if_missed_inr.purpose: Synthetic loss exposure when a fraudulent transaction is not stopped.
fraud_loss_if_missed_inr.construction: Uses transaction amount, payment-method-specific synthetic loss-given-fraud factor, and a fixed operational component.
fraud_loss_if_missed_inr.warning: Synthetic evaluation proxy; do not present as a real-world loss rate.
